focus: Concrete fix per recorded failure mode, with the observable that proves each
noveltyJustification: Each of the 12 fixes is partially new: the failure it addresses was recorded earlier, while the function-level change and its observable are new; the pass also closes the last open question, adding the simplicity bonus.
keyQuestions: What does each runtime's prepare text tell the sender about keeping details out of the note, and does it over-promise what a fresh session can recover through the History Lookup?
What claim text and History Lookup offer does the receiver read on OpenCode versus Pi, and what makes a receiver leave a claim unverified instead of running the lookup?
How do the OpenCode and Pi session readers feed the History Lookup, including their tool-call argument shapes and secret redaction, and what does each fail to recover?
Does model and effort carry on relaunch for each runtime, and where can it silently degrade or be dropped?

Which known limits (OpenCode store without a directory column, AI_SESSION_CHILD leaking into test sandboxes, the 160-character preview cut, a double nudge from two hooks) cause a hop to fail, and what concrete fix addresses each?
answeredQuestions: Which known limits (OpenCode store without a directory column, AI_SESSION_CHILD leaking into test sandboxes, the 160-character preview cut, a double nudge from two hooks) cause a hop to fail, and what concrete fix addresses each?
ruledOut: Fixing the model by making the receiver read the note harder
Raising the preview without a bound

graphEvents.label: Prepare text must name the lookup and forbid unrecoverable claims
Claim seed needs a lookup-before-asking step
Offer needs authority over the note
Browse must return the whole part or a load pointer

label: Sender over-promise fix: handoffText in nudge.cjs must say a detail kept out of the note is still recoverable through the claim's History Lookup and forbid writing that a fresh session cannot recover it; observable is a hop whose note omits a value without any unrecoverable instruction.

Seed verification fix: seedText must add a step before Continue the work telling the receiver to run the printed History Lookup when Remaining work names a detail the note does not carry; observable is a history-lookup call before any operator question.

Offer authority fix: buildHistoryLookupBody must state that the note is not authoritative about what the sender's history holds, so a receiver tries the lookup before concluding a detail is unrecoverable.

Preview fix: browse previews must carry the whole first part within the reply budget or attach an explicit load pointer per reference; observable is the side word at character 295 appearing in a browse reply without a second call.

Argument-shape fix: toolCallBlock must preserve a string argument, by parsing JSON or keeping it under a value key, instead of replacing it with an empty object; observable is a session whose string tool input returns in a loaded turn.

Projection fix: give projection defects their own refusal code and skip the offending tool-call pair instead of failing the whole read; observable is a session with one orphaned result still returning every other turn.

OpenCode folder-proof fix: fail closed at mint when the session table has no directory column, or record the folder on the locator and verify it against store metadata; observable is a cross-folder note getting no offer rather than another project's turns.

Pi keying fix: record the Pi store key on the locator at mint and fall back to an exact-id scan of project directories when the note cwd misses; observable is a session started in a subdirectory still being found.

Carry-audit fix: append a relaunch-args line with model, provider, effort and name to relaunch.log from the wrapper, and read a Pi receiver's session header in score.cjs; observable is carry reading kept or dropped, never unobservable.

OpenCode 2 carry limitation: there is no model flag to replay, so emit one warning when the receiver's effective model differs from the sender's and state the limitation in the runtime matrix; observable is a warning line instead of silence.

Pi held-nudge fix: persist the held text or defer the level write until delivery, and deliver any held text on the next agent_settled; observable is a nudge surviving a host reload between hold and delivery.

Child-flag fix: unset AI_SESSION_CHILD in the wrapper before launching a runtime and in the live-hop harness tmux line; observable is a hop started from a dispatched worker still nudging, preparing and claiming.

direction: Fixing the model by making the receiver read the note harder
reason: The receiver read the note exactly; the note was wrong and the offer had no authority over it.

direction: Raising the preview without a bound
reason: The reply budget is what keeps the lookup inside a model-visible payload; the fix is whole-part preview or a load pointer inside the same budget.
